in_hebrew.name: גרד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Gard means ‘valiant, strong one’. This name is derived from the Hebrew root ‘gard’, which means ‘to tread down, to trample, to be fierce, to be strong’.

in_greek.name: Γάρδος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Gard is derived from the Greek word ‘gardos’, which means ‘ward, guardian, keeper’. This name was borne by several ancient Greeks, including a legendary hero who was the father of the Trojan hero Hector.

in_latin.name: Gardus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Gard is also derived from the same root as the Greek name Gardos, meaning ‘ward, guardian, keeper’. This name was borne by several saints and holy figures in the Christian tradition.
